reasoning: While both plans focus on easy running, Plan B demonstrates a more strategic approach to improving trail running speed. The inclusion of a tempo run (threshold effort) in Plan B is crucial for developing the necessary speed and endurance for faster trail running. Plan A solely relies on easy runs, which, while important for base building, won't significantly improve speed. The cross-training days in Plan B also offer a valuable opportunity for aerobic development with reduced impact, aiding recovery and preventing overuse injuries.
